sources.name: grilling (mattpocock/skills)
sources.purpose: Design-tree, frontier-round owner interview (/grill-me, /grill-with-docs) that batches every question whose prerequisites are settled, gives a recommended answer per question, dispatches sub-agents for facts (never asks the owner for lookups), and ends when the design tree frontier is empty. Candidate source for EPDS owner-question step when no evidence exists.
